claims.statement: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) replace convolutional U-Net backbones with standard Transformer blocks operating on latent patches.
claims.evidence_excerpt: We propose a new class of diffusion models based on the Transformer architecture. We find that DiTs are scalable backbones.
script_spans: Modern generative video discarded convolutional U-Nets in favor of Diffusion Transformers.

claims.statement: DiT uses adaptive layer normalization (adaLN) to condition intermediate layers on diffusion timestep and guidance embeddings.
claims.evidence_excerpt: adaLN-Zero initializes scale and shift parameters with zeros, improving training stability.
script_spans: Conditioning happens through adaptive layer norm zero, stabilizing training from the start.
